name: sports-event-manager-root
description: Root workspace to launch all Sports Event Manager services concurrently

scripts.start: concurrently -n "AI_SERVICE,EXPRESS_API,REACT_FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "cd Backend/ai_service && python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000" "cd Backend/server && node index.js" "cd Frontend && npm run dev"
